learner_operation: Read the third variable, back substitute through the middle and top equations, and select the ordered solution vector. Matching a vector by substitution or using legitimate cancellation is also mathematical reasoning; a fixed bank sign or position is not.

fixed_features.feature: Three-variable upper-triangular equations with unit leading coefficients
fixed_features.justification: Canonical example and tutorial 3149 establish two substitution stages. Nonunit pivots and augmented-matrix reading are separate KPs.

fixed_features.feature: Five-choice radio response in angle or column vector notation
fixed_features.justification: All 13 captured banks use this contract, with one correct ordered vector.

fixed_features.feature: Per-profile source coefficient triples; small rational arithmetic
fixed_features.justification: Conservative workload bound, allowing RHSs and answer roles to vary without new prerequisites. Source banks span positive, negative, zero, half and third coordinates.

stages_examined: normal construction and CLI fingerprint rejection/resampling
publisher validation, stable identities and captured inventory deduplication
learner history exclusion and weighted selection
delivery.result: 60/60 normal, 55/60 controlled and 5/5 exact batch records survive. Five original-parameter duplicates removed; at least four keys per fixed bank remain. Batch has four profiles and keys 0,1,4, with distinct non-sign-only systems; no tested common surface rule answers all five. Easy-only weighted selection uses hash sampling, not bank cues; positive easy weight makes every eligible batch record reachable.

limitations: Finite focused audit does not prove absence of every shortcut.
q-20451 lacks source solution, key and difficulty; unsupported and not represented as complete replay.

Selection conclusions use inventory basis 5578 and actual read-only rules; no live learner history, future entity IDs or active policy weights were supplied. Zero easy weight excludes these records; an unconfigured policy selects the lowest ID.
A single-item subgroup cannot establish a repeated shortcut. Exact batch measurements are reported separately from controlled evidence.
Original instructional banks can include partial-coordinate simplifications. These can be legitimate mathematical reasoning; this audit distinguishes them from bank-only answer cues.
